name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines, nurtured in his father's small garage in the Highlands. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Edinburgh, and immediately sought a position in a junior racing team, eager to apply his knowledge to real-world challenges. He quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for problem-solving and a collaborative approach to team management.

His experience spans over two decades, during which he's worked with several teams, each time refining his skills and expanding his technical expertise. Alistair believes in empowering his team, fostering an environment where every member feels valued and heard. His flexible leadership style, coupled with his meticulous attention to detail, makes him an ideal Technical Director, capable of adapting to the ever-changing demands of the racing world. What sets Alistair apart is his ability to balance cutting-edge innovation with practical, reliable solutions.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a wiry build and a perpetually thoughtful expression.
